headline: DO: call Seth B. — a written offer on 355 Comanche dies at 7 PM tonight and the counter is already staged. · WATCH: Whispering Pines closes TOMORROW and has been silent since 7/23; the fleet also went dark 17½ hours overnight.

Still no 6:25 AM letter as of 9:20 — two mornings running. But the composer IS alive: a fresh 🗞️ Today task landed at 9:18 this morning, so the board is being rebuilt even though the letter hasn't sent.

Zero BLOCKED lines, and what ran, ran clean. The 9:15 milestone engine deliberately scanned the whole 19-hour gap and correctly found nothing unfired — the overnight hole cost visibility, not a missed milestone.

The counter recommendation, net sheet and comps are already staged as a Gmail draft; countering also voids their clock and hands it to you. Call first, then send

REFERRAL VOICEMAIL, NOW TWO DAYS OLD. She called Thursday afternoon offering a referral for someone in Springville and asked for a callback by name. A referral offer is the cheapest listing at-bat on this board, and after Wednesday there is not one dated closing on the books
